Ava (CEO): Quick heads-up — All-hands Friday 2:00pm PT. Plan: 15m exec roundup, 20m demos, 15m AMA. Please drop 1–2 questions in this thread by Thu 5pm PT. Recording + slides will be posted afterwards. /cc @Sam @Maya

```
- Exec highlights (Ava) — 15m
- Product demos: Redwood Optimize & Dedicated rollout — 20m
- Ops/Incidents recap — 10m
- AMA — 15m
- Closing + takeaways — 5m

Ava (CEO): Yes to both — Diego, please coordinate slide with Sam. Lena, ping me if you need a minute for context.
Sam (VP Product): Reminder: Submit written Qs in this thread by Thu 5pm PT. We'll prioritize high upvotes :thumbsup:

```

- Launch window for Dedicated burst: May
- Reduced median p50 by ~10% via runtime kernel update
- Action: ENG to roll perf tests into CI by end of Q2

Maya (People Ops): Takeaways: add 2 survey questions to post-all-hands survey (remote experience + clarity on rollout)
